news.title: 台積設5億美元基金 盼扶植新「輝達」
news.summary: 台積電董事會日前通過以不超過5億美元的資金設立投資公司TSMC Ventures（暫稱）。資深副總經理暨副共同營運長張曉強接受日經訪問時表示，台積電希望扶植可能成為下一家輝達或博通的新創企業，投資對象也可能擴及供應商與上游夥伴，擴大生態系到直接客戶以外。
news.title_en: TSMC sets up USD 500000000 fund, hopes to nurture new 'Nvidia'
news.summary_en: TSMC's board recently approved the establishment of investment company TSMC Ventures (tentative name) with funds not exceeding USD 500000000. Senior Vice President and Deputy Co-COO Chang Hsiao-chiang told Nikkei in an interview that TSMC hopes to nurture startups that could become the next Nvidia or Broadcom; investment targets may also extend to suppliers and upstream partners, expanding the ecosystem beyond direct customers.

news.title_en: Without Jensen Huang, Taiwan stocks still soar? Guo Zherong says 'probability of return not small'; reveals 3 beneficiary stocks
news.summary_en: NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO, drawing market attention; however, Taiwan stocks on 13 opened high and volatile, intraday surged over 1300 points, closed up 583 points at 43675 points. Moore Investment Consulting analyst Guo Zherong believes Huang's departure mainly affects short-term market sentiment, does not represent change in AI industry outlook, may even drive custom chip demand; names Alchip （3035）, MediaTek （2454） and AMD (Advanced Micro Devices) among 3 beneficiary stocks. 《Full article...》

news.title_en: Huang Renxun's resignation aftermath! NVIDIA AI chain adds variables, experts warn Taiwan factories regulatory risk
news.summary_en: NVIDIA founder Huang Renxun embroiled in extramarital affair and intelligence security controversy, resigns as chairman, CEO, and director 3 positions, shocking global AI industry, whether Taiwan supply chain affected draws attention. Taiwan Institute of Economic Research Industrial Economics Database Director Liu Peizhen points out that currently including TSMC （2330）, Foxconn （2317）, Wistron （3231）, and Chin Yuan Electronics （2449） and other major partners have not seen order cancellations or capacity adjustments and other substantive impacts, but what really needs attention is subsequent national security investigations and US policy changes, once China chip export controls further tighten, Taiwan factories may face more complex compliance risks. 《Full text...》

news.title: 顧及輝達客戶關係 鴻海事前低調溝通讓法說會不失焦
news.summary: 鴻海（2317）12日舉行法人說明會，董事長劉揚偉親自對外說明最新營運成果與未來布局。正如市場預期，AI伺服器與相關先進運算業務成為整場會議的絕對核心。據了解，鑑於同業日前評論輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳外遇事件，鴻海在本次法說會前下足功夫對媒體、投資人進行事前溝通，避免讓該起事件持續延燒，讓雙方合作成果失焦。
news.title_en: Considering NVIDIA customer relationship, Foxconn communicates low-key beforehand to keep analyst meeting focused
news.summary_en: Foxconn （2317）12 day holds analyst meeting, Chairman Liu Yangwei personally explains latest operating results and future layout. As market expected, AI servers and related advanced computing business become absolute core of entire meeting. According to understanding, given peers recently commented on NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's affair scandal, Foxconn put in great effort before this analyst meeting to pre-communicate with media and investors, to avoid letting the incident continue to ferment, causing both parties' cooperation results to lose focus.

news.title_en: Foxconn analyst meeting / Liu Yangwei: Customer AI demand strong in short term, long-term impact still to be observed
news.summary_en: Foxconn （2317）12 day holds analyst meeting, regarding whether customer investment in AI data centers is slowing? Chairman Liu Yangwei says currently seeing AI demand continuously increasing, mainly from users, which can be divided into four categories: large language model makers (Model Maker), cloud service providers (CSP), government and enterprises, four major categories.

news.summary: PC品牌大廠華碩（2357）12日舉行法說會，華碩共同執行長胡書賓分析，儘管近期AI伺服器產業面臨資本市場融資條件趨緊，以及美國期中大選後，各地對資料中心建置監管轉趨嚴謹等兩項負面因子，但AI發展是長期趨勢，華碩對明年伺服器業務以高雙位數成長為目標，並朝三位數成長努力。

news.title: 華碩法說會／預告 PC 產業寒冬將至 明年全球市場出貨恐減10～15％
news.summary: PC品牌大廠華碩（2357）12日召開法說會，預告PC產業寒冬將至。華碩預期，從今年的第4季到明年第1、第2季度，PC市場可能會面臨到幾個季度產業需求的逆風，華碩共同執行長許先越指出，預期明年整體PC市場出貨量將年減10-15%，至明年上半年，華碩PC常規業務獲利將承受一些壓力。

news.title: AI 賦能碳管理 華碩攜手臺大醫院北護分院推動醫療永續轉型
news.summary: 華碩（2357）10日宣布與臺大醫院北護分院 簽署「永續醫療與ESG數位轉型合作備忘錄（MOU）」，首次以技術顧問角色協助醫療院所建立醫療服務碳足跡，並結合華碩碳數據管理平台、AI應用與永續管理實務經驗，協助院方深化碳管理並強化減碳決策，推動低碳醫療發展。

news.title: 公股首家！ 兆豐金首次參與COP31會議 分享金融業淨零轉型經驗

news.title: 中租法說會／總資產突破1兆元大關 陳鳳龍正面看待2027年展望
news.summary: 中租-KY（5871）12日舉行法人說明會，截至今年第3季底，合併總資產已突破1兆元新台幣大關，過去十年年化複合成長率達13%。董事長陳鳳龍也釋出2027年初步展望，隨著中國大陸資產品質朝向改善、台灣資產品質第3季、第4季預期逐漸穩定、東協國家因油價上升衝擊當地經濟的影響性可望逐漸消退，目前內部仍朝著正向看待。

news.title: 仁寶分割伺服器事業群 交由旗下雲銳智慧科技
news.summary: 仁寶（2324）宣布將伺服器相關事業群分割，並交由旗下百分之百持有的雲銳智慧科技。仁寶表示，分割主要原因是優化資源配置及提升營運綜效，並強化專業分工及提升營運效率，屬集團內組織架構之重組與調整，故對本公司股東權益並無影響。

news.title: 仁寶將赴美參加 Supercomputing 年度盛會 展現新世代 AI基礎設施方案
news.summary: 仁寶（2324）將於11月17日至19日登場的全球高效能運算年度盛會Supercomputing 2026（SC26）上，展示整合NVIDIA新世代運算與網路技術的AI基礎設施解決方案。

news.title: 仁寶串聯 NVIDIA 新世代運算與網路技術 加速 AI 基礎設施規模化發展
news.summary: 仁寶（2324）10日表示將於 11 月 17 日至 19 日登場的全球高效能運算年度盛會 Supercomputing 2026（SC26）上，展示整合 NVIDIA 新世代運算與網路技術的 AI 基礎設施解決方案。憑藉從晶片、伺服器平台到 AI 網路互連架構的系統工程與整合能力，仁寶將展現支援大規模分散式 AI 運算的關鍵技術布局。

news.title: 東元法說會／AIDC 接單破百億 檳城新廠啟動、明年四大事業群看旺
news.summary: 東元（1504）12日召開法說會，總經理高飛鳶指出，今年AI資料中心（AIDC）整體接單上看逾百億元，截至上月底已達成目標八成以上。隨著在手訂單明年陸續完工認列，加上馬來西亞檳城新廠投產，他看好2027年四大事業群營運全面向上。
